style_prefix: 2D editorial stickman illustration for a sophisticated English explainer video. Simple expressive adult stick figures with round heads, dot eyes, clean dark navy-black ink lines, warm off-white paper-like background, restrained muted red and amber accent shapes, flat lightly textured 2D rendering, newspaper/editorial illustration sensibility, strong silhouettes and readable body language, simplified airport and airline props. No photorealism, no realistic skin, no 3D render, no cinematic photography, no lens bokeh, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.
